title: The Many "Facets" of Halide Ions in the Chemistry of Colloidal Inorganic Nanocrystals.

cmo_edges.parameter_range_tested: Chloride, bromide, and iodide ions across nanocrystal syntheses
cmo_edges.proposed_mechanism: Halide ions selectively adsorb onto specific crystal facets and form complexes with metal precursors, regulating surface energy and anisotropic growth kinetics.
cmo_edges.quantitative_effect: Provides high level of shape and compositional control in colloidal nanomaterials.
cmo_edges.evidence_quote: Halide ions affect the NC growth kinetics through several means, including selective binding on crystal facets, complexation with the precursors, and oxidative etching.

untested_assumptions_or_limitations: Review article covering general mechanisms across multiple distinct material classes (metals, semiconductors, perovskites) rather than a single standardized protocol
